name: ChemElucid
description: ChemElucid / MolPuzzle-Gym anonymous review package for inspecting and running the public benchmark interface, public task bundle format, episode logging schema, scoring scripts, cached aggregate leaderboard data, and sanitized toy HRE examples. Full private HRE assets, private grader labels, withheld probe annotations, and complete expert-curated reasoning graphs are intentionally omitted during double-blind review.
citeAs: @misc{chemelucid_2026, title={ChemElucid: Diagnosing Scientific Agents in Molecular Structure Elucidation}, author={Anonymous Authors}, year={2026}, note={NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets track submission.}}
rai:dataCollection: The anonymous review package contains public task bundles for the review-time benchmark interface and sanitized toy HRE examples that demonstrate the scoring schema. Private HRE assets and withheld-probe labels used by the hidden grader are not included in this package.
rai:dataUseCases: Reviewers can inspect task schemas, run the public tool interface, validate task bundles, execute L1/L2/L3 scoring definitions on sanitized examples, and inspect anonymous aggregate leaderboard tables. Exact private-grader evaluation requires controlled-release private HRE assets.
rai:dataLimitations: This review package is not the full hidden-evaluation release. It omits complete chemistry-specific HRE templates, private grader labels, withheld probe annotations, and expert-curated reasoning graphs to preserve hidden-evaluation integrity during double-blind review.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: None. The dataset contains no personal data, no human-subjects data, and no sensitive content. All molecules are small organic compounds documented in open-access chemistry sources.
rai:dataBiases: The public review tasks and sanitized examples are intended for interface and scoring inspection, not as a complete characterization of the private hidden-evaluation set.
rai:dataSocialImpact: Positive impact: the artifact makes the benchmark interface, logging, and diagnostic scoring code inspectable while protecting hidden-evaluation assets from premature release. Potential negative impact includes overfitting once private assets are released; mitigations include maintaining a public/private boundary and controlled post-publication release.
